SELECT REQUEST_ID,PROGRAM_ID,OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER,CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE,LAST_UPDATED_BY,LAST_UPDATE_DATE,LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN, TRANSACTION_ID,TRANSACTION_NUM,TRANSACTION_CATEGORY,TRANSACTION_TYPE, BUSINESS_TYPE,TRANSACTION_DATE,PENALTY_CALC_DATE,COMPANY_ID,TRANSACTION_AMOUNT, CURRENCY_CODE,PAYMENT_METHOD,BANK_SLIP_NUM,BANK_ACCOUNT_ID,BP_ID, BP_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID,BP_BANK_NAME,BP_BANK_BRANCH_NAME,BP_BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM, BP_BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME,REVERSED_FLAG,REVERSED_TRX_ID,REVERSED_DATE,POSTED_FLAG, CONTRACT_ID,DESCRIPTION,SOURCE_DOC_CATEGORY,SOURCE_DOC_ID,SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID ,HANDLING_CHARGE,WRITE_OFF_FLAG,WRITE_OFF_AMOUNT,FULL_WRITE_OFF_DATE,IMPORT_FLAG FROM csh_transaction
TRANSACTION_ID = #{transactionId}

SELECT t.transaction_id, t.contract_id, t.CURRENCY_CODE, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.CODE = 'CSH301_TRANSACTION_TYPE' AND v.code_value = t.transaction_type ) transaction_type_n, ( SELECT fc.currency_name FROM fnd_currency fc WHERE fc.currency_code = t.CURRENCY_CODE ) AS currency_n, ( SELECT cba.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME FROM csh_bank_account cba WHERE cba.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = t.bank_account_id ) AS BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME, ( SELECT cba.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM FROM csh_bank_account cba WHERE cba.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = t.bank_account_id ) AS BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM, t.transaction_date, ( SELECT bp.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master bp WHERE bp.BP_ID = t.BP_ID ) AS bp_name, t.BP_BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME, t.BP_BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM, t.CREATED_BY, ( SELECT s.DESCRIPTION FROM sys_user s WHERE s.USER_ID = t.CREATED_BY ) CREATED_BY_n, ( SELECT c.contract_number FROM con_contract c WHERE c.contract_id = t.contract_id ) contract_number, ( SELECT c.contract_name FROM con_contract c WHERE c.contract_id = t.contract_id ) contract_name, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'CSH.POST_SELECT' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID AND scv.value = t.posted_flag) posted_flag_n, t.posted_flag, (CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM csh_transaction ct WHERE ct.source_doc_id = t.transaction_id AND ct.transaction_type = 'REFUND' AND ct.reversed_flag = 'N') = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) refund_flag, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'HLS_REVERSED_FLAG' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID AND scv.value = t.reversed_flag) reversed_flag_n, t.WRITE_OFF_FLAG, t.WRITE_OFF_AMOUNT, t.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT, t.TRANSACTION_DATE, t.reversed_flag
FROM csh_transaction t
1=1
AND t.transaction_id = #{transactionId}

SELECT ct.*, (SELECT scv.DESCRIPTION FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'CSH.PAYMENT_METHOD' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = ct.payment_method) gathering_method, cb.bank_name bankName, (select hbm.bp_code from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = ct.bp_id) as bp_code, (select hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = ct.bp_id) as bp_name, cba.bank_account_name, cba.currency currency_code, cba.bank_account_num, nvl((select sum(wo.csh_write_off_amount) from csh_write_off wo where wo.csh_transaction_id = ct.transaction_id and wo.write_off_type = 'REFUND'), 0) return_write_off_amount, nvl((select sum(wo.csh_write_off_amount) from csh_write_off wo where wo.csh_transaction_id = ct.transaction_id and wo.write_off_type != 'REFUND'), 0) sum_write_off_amount, (nvl(ct.transaction_amount, 0) - nvl(ct.write_off_amount, 0)) can_return_amount, nvl((select sum(cwom.csh_write_off_amount) from csh_write_off_match cwom where cwom.write_flag != 'Y' AND cwom.csh_transaction_id = ct.transaction_id), 0) macth_write_off_amount FROM csh_transaction ct left join csh_bank_account cba on cba.bank_account_id = ct.bank_account_id left join csh_bank cb on cb.bank_id = cba.bank_id where ct.transaction_id = #{transactionId,jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT ct.transaction_num, ct.currency_code, ct.transaction_date as transaction_date, ct.transaction_date as accounting_period, ct.transaction_amount, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'CHS.CURRENCY_TYPE' and scv.value = ct.currency_code) currency_code_n
FROM csh_transaction ct
1=1
and ct.transaction_id = #{transactionId}

SELECT t1.*, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = t1.refund_flag) refund_flag_n FROM (SELECT t.*, (select v.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.code = 'CSH301_TRANSACTION_TYPE' AND v.code_value = t.transaction_type) transaction_type_n, (SELECT fc.currency_name FROM fnd_currency fc WHERE fc.currency_code = t.CURRENCY_CODE) AS currency_n, (SELECT cba.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME FROM csh_bank_account cba WHERE cba.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = t.bank_account_id) AS BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME, (SELECT cba.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM FROM csh_bank_account cba WHERE cba.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = t.bank_account_id) AS BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM, (SELECT bp.bp_code FROM hls_bp_master bp WHERE bp.BP_ID = t.BP_ID) AS bp_code, (SELECT bp.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master bp WHERE bp.BP_ID = t.BP_ID) AS bp_name,
(SELECT bp.BP_TYPE FROM hls_bp_master bp WHERE bp.BP_ID = t.BP_ID) AS bp_type,
(SELECT hbt.description FROM hls_bp_master bp, hls_bp_type hbt WHERE bp.BP_ID = t.BP_ID AND hbt.bp_type = bp.BP_TYPE) AS bp_type_n,
nvl((SELECT SUM(nvl(wo.csh_write_off_amount, 0)) FROM csh_write_off wo WHERE wo.csh_transaction_id = t.transaction_id AND wo.reversed_flag = 'N' AND wo.write_off_type = 'REFUND'), 0) return_write_off_amount,
nvl((SELECT SUM(nvl(wo.csh_write_off_amount, 0)) FROM csh_write_off wo WHERE wo.csh_transaction_id = t.transaction_id AND wo.reversed_flag = 'N' AND wo.write_off_type != 'REFUND'), 0) sum_write_off_amount,
(nvl(t.transaction_amount, 0) - nvl(t.write_off_amount, 0)) can_return_amount, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'CSH.PAYMENT_METHOD' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = t.payment_method) payment_method_n,
(SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'CSH.POST_SELECT' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = t.posted_flag) posted_flag_n,
(case when (select count(1) from csh_transaction ct where ct.source_doc_id = t.transaction_id AND ct.transaction_type = 'REFUND' and ct.reversed_flag = 'N') = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) refund_flag, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'HLS_REVERSED_FLAG' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = t.reversed_flag) reversed_flag_n,
(select c.contract_id from csh_write_off o, con_contract c where o.write_off_id = t.source_doc_line_id and t.source_doc_category = 'CSH_WRITE_OFF' and o.write_off_type = 'RECEIPT_DEPOSIT' and c.contract_id = o.contract_id and o.reversed_flag = 'N')deposit_contract_id,
(select c.contract_name from csh_write_off o, con_contract c where o.write_off_id = t.source_doc_line_id and t.source_doc_category = 'CSH_WRITE_OFF' and o.write_off_type = 'RECEIPT_DEPOSIT' and c.contract_id = o.contract_id and o.reversed_flag = 'N')deposit_contract_name,
(select c.contract_number from csh_write_off o, con_contract c where o.write_off_id = t.source_doc_line_id and t.source_doc_category = 'CSH_WRITE_OFF' and o.write_off_type = 'RECEIPT_DEPOSIT' and c.contract_id = o.contract_id and o.reversed_flag = 'N')deposit_contract_number,
(select cc.contract_number from csh_payment_req_hd hd, csh_payment_req_ln ln, con_contract cc where t.source_doc_category = 'CSH_PAYMENT_REQ' and t.source_doc_id = hd.payment_req_id and ln.payment_req_id = hd.payment_req_id and ln.payment_req_ln_id = (select max(ll.payment_req_ln_id) from csh_payment_req_ln ll where ll.payment_req_id = hd.payment_req_id) and cc.contract_id = ln.source_doc_id) contract_number,
(select cc.contract_name from csh_payment_req_hd hd, csh_payment_req_ln ln, con_contract cc where t.source_doc_category = 'CSH_PAYMENT_REQ' and t.source_doc_id = hd.payment_req_id and ln.payment_req_id = hd.payment_req_id and ln.payment_req_ln_id = (select max(ll.payment_req_ln_id) from csh_payment_req_ln ll where ll.payment_req_id = hd.payment_req_id) and cc.contract_id = ln.source_doc_id) contract_name,
(select hd.payment_req_number from csh_payment_req_hd hd where t.source_doc_category = 'CSH_PAYMENT_REQ' and t.source_doc_id = hd.payment_req_id) payment_req_number,
(select hd.apply_pay_date from csh_payment_req_hd hd where t.source_doc_category = 'CSH_PAYMENT_REQ' and t.source_doc_id = hd.payment_req_id) apply_pay_date,
(select hd.payment_req_date from csh_payment_req_hd hd where t.source_doc_category = 'CSH_PAYMENT_REQ' and t.source_doc_id = hd.payment_req_id) payment_req_date,
(select bp.bp_code from csh_payment_req_hd hd, csh_payment_req_ln ln, hls_bp_master bp where t.source_doc_category = 'CSH_PAYMENT_REQ' and t.source_doc_id = hd.payment_req_id and ln.payment_req_id = hd.payment_req_id and ln.payment_req_ln_id = (select max(ll.payment_req_ln_id) from csh_payment_req_ln ll where ll.payment_req_id = hd.payment_req_id) and bp.bp_id = ln.bp_id) payment_bp_code, (select bp.bp_name from csh_payment_req_hd hd, csh_payment_req_ln ln, hls_bp_master bp where t.source_doc_category = 'CSH_PAYMENT_REQ' and t.source_doc_id = hd.payment_req_id and ln.payment_req_id = hd.payment_req_id and ln.payment_req_ln_id = (select max(ll.payment_req_ln_id) from csh_payment_req_ln ll where ll.payment_req_id = hd.payment_req_id) and bp.bp_id = ln.bp_id) payment_bp_name,
(select ln.bp_bank_account_num from csh_payment_req_hd hd, csh_payment_req_ln ln where t.source_doc_category = 'CSH_PAYMENT_REQ' and t.source_doc_id = hd.payment_req_id and ln.payment_req_id = hd.payment_req_id and ln.payment_req_ln_id = (select max(ll.payment_req_ln_id) from csh_payment_req_ln ll where ll.payment_req_id = hd.payment_req_id)) payment_bp_bank_account_num, (select ln.bp_bank_account_name from csh_payment_req_hd hd, csh_payment_req_ln ln where t.source_doc_category = 'CSH_PAYMENT_REQ' and t.source_doc_id = hd.payment_req_id and ln.payment_req_id = hd.payment_req_id and ln.payment_req_ln_id = (select max(ll.payment_req_ln_id) from csh_payment_req_ln ll where ll.payment_req_id = hd.payment_req_id)) payment_bp_bank_account_name, (select ln.bp_bank_branch_name from csh_payment_req_hd hd, csh_payment_req_ln ln where t.source_doc_category = 'CSH_PAYMENT_REQ' and t.source_doc_id = hd.payment_req_id and ln.payment_req_id = hd.payment_req_id and ln.payment_req_ln_id = (select max(ll.payment_req_ln_id) from csh_payment_req_ln ll where ll.payment_req_id = hd.payment_req_id)) payment_bp_bank_branch_name FROM csh_transaction t) t1
AND (t1.bank_account_num like concat(CONCAT('%',#{queryInfo}),'%') or t1.bp_name like concat(CONCAT('%',#{queryInfo}),'%') or t1.payment_req_number like concat(CONCAT('%',#{queryInfo}),'%') or t1.contract_number like concat(CONCAT('%',#{queryInfo}),'%') or t1.payment_bp_name like concat(CONCAT('%',#{queryInfo}),'%') or t1.transaction_num like concat(CONCAT('%',#{queryInfo}),'%') )
order by t1.transaction_num desc

SELECT ct.*, (select m.bp_name from hls_bp_master m where m.bp_id = ct.bp_id) bp_name FROM CSH_TRANSACTION ct WHERE ct.SOURCE_TRANSACTION_ID in ( select ct.TRANSACTION_ID from csh_transaction ct INNER JOIN csh_allocation_receipt car on ct.TRANSACTION_ID = car.TRANSACTION_ID INNER JOIN csh_allocation ca ON car.allocation_id = ca.allocation_id INNER JOIN CSH_ALLOCATION_ADVANCE caa ON caa.allocation_id = ca.allocation_id WHERE caa.CONTRACT_ID = #{contractId} AND caa.CASHFLOW_ID=#{cashflowId} )
